findings.title: Visible-range effect never re-runs when the first series is added
`use-chart-provider.ts` exceeds the line/function guidance
findings.description:
The file is 366 lines and the mount `useEffect` is a single ~150-line function (the `teardown` closure already extracted), both beyond the project's "~300 lines / ~50 lines … where practical" guide. This is largely comment volume and the effect legitimately shares local closures (`provider`, `observer`, `disposers`, `teardown`) that are awkward to split. The ESLint suppression comment even acknowledges the file is "~60% over" as the reason for extracting the facade rather than inlining it. Noting for awareness; the split into `chart-facade.ts`/`chart-operations.ts` already does the reasonable amount of factoring.

---

Unverified (no runtime access): the Playwright pixel assertions in `e2e/chart-live.spec.ts` (main pane painted in the `--color-surface` color, and that the time-axis strip of an **empty** chart renders more than one color so `axisHasContrast` is `true`) depend on lightweight-charts v5's real rendering behavior. I confirmed the logic and that the tokens/values line up (`#161a1e` → `22,26,30,255`), but I could not run the browser to confirm the empty-chart axis actually paints contrasting chrome. These are designed to be run in CI via `pnpm test:e2e`; worth confirming they're green there.
